map.促销（折扣/满减/优惠券）设计 使用指南: Promotion (Discount / Threshold Gift / Coupon) Design User Guide
map.输入原价、折扣力度、满减门槛或优惠券面额，计算到手价、让利幅度与利润率影响，辅助: Enter list price, discount depth, threshold-gift tier or coupon face value to compute the final price, concession magnitude and margin impact, assisting promotion design and estimation.
map.实付 = 标价 × (1−折扣率): Final price = list price × (1 − discount rate)
map.本工具按折扣率、满减门槛与优惠券叠加规则计算到手价与优惠力度，支持多方案对比。: This tool computes the final price and discount depth from the discount rate, threshold-gift tiers and coupon stacking rules, and supports comparing multiple schemes.
map.到手价：录入标价、折扣与满减，算最终到手与优惠金额。: Final price: enter the list price, discount and threshold gift to compute the final price and the saving.
map.方案对比：对比\"满300减50\"与\"8.5折\"哪种对客更优、对店更省。: Scheme comparison: compare "spend 300 save 50" with "15% off" for which is better for customers and cheaper for the store.
map.教学演示：演示优惠券叠加的先后与互斥规则。: Teaching demo: demonstrate the ordering and mutual-exclusion rules of coupon stacking.
map.：示例：标价 400、满 300 减 50、再 9 折，到手=(400−50)×: : Example: list price 400, 50 off over 300, then 10% off → final=(400−50)×0.9=315, saving CNY 85.
map.满减和折扣叠加？: Do threshold gifts and discounts stack?
map.常见先满减后打折，顺序不同到手价不同，须按活动规则确定。结果仅供电商运营测算、选: Promotions often apply the threshold gift before the percentage discount, and the order changes the final price, so follow the campaign rules.
